content: T2HELIX SSE TRANSPORT SHIPPED — 2026-05-11, branch feat/sse-transport, commit 5a6a271. mcp/server.js now accepts --transport sse flag, spins HTTP on port 3742. GET /sse opens stream, POST /messages routes tool calls. stdio path unchanged. Both transports can run simultaneously against the same chronicle.db — meaning a Claude Code session and a web chat session can share one T2Helix instance in real time. Multi-seat memory without extra architecture. Verified: GET /sse returns endpoint event with sessionId, unknown sessionId 400s correctly, 44/44 smoke still pass. This is the unlock from Claude Code-only to any Claude surface. Next: PostToolBatch/PreCompact/Stop hooks for self-improvement loop.
